text:
Maya Chen: Kickoff for Catalyst Grove onboarding — quick sync on owners, success criteria, and 30d timeline. cc @Priya :wave:
Priya Nair: Thanks Maya. Customer priorities: SSO + data ingest + validation + docs. PM lead: Priya. Any immediate blockers?
Diego Alvarez: I'll own infra & API integration. Target to expose test endpoint by Thu. Need service account creds + sample payload.
Samir Patel: I'll build the eval set and basic prompt templates. Also want to run a prompt-engineering workshop once integration is live.
Lena Ortiz: I'll handle enablement and training materials. Proposed workshop dates: next Wed/Thu afternoon — any conflicts?
OnboardBot: playbook created — /playbooks/catalyst-grove — checklist template applied :robot_face:
Priya Nair: Customer success criteria (as agreed):
1) SSO login (Okta SAML) working for 10 users
2) Data ingestion of 10k rows with schema validation
3) Baseline quality: hallucination rate < 5% on eval set
4) Handed-off quickstart + runbook
Maya Chen: Known risks: schema mismatch on ingest, region quotas, and model latency spikes during bulk tests. Recommend canary rollout + tracing dashboard.
Diego Alvarez: Region is us-west-2. I'll request KMS keys and a dedicated pool for bulk inference tests. @Samir please confirm model variants needed for eval.
Samir Patel: Confirmed — 3 variants (base, quantized, tuned). I'll get a baseline run on staging by Friday and add hallucination/precision metrics.
Priya Nair: Proposed 30-day timeline:
```
Week 0 (this week): creds, svc acct, sample payload, calendar invites
Week 1: ingest + smoke tests + SSO validation
Week 2: full eval runs + workshop + performance tuning
Week 3: stability run, docs handoff, success review
```
Also propose 30min standups M/W/F for first two weeks.
Lena Ortiz: I'll draft the workshop deck and send invites once dates confirmed. Will also prepare the weekly onboarding pulse template.
Maya Chen: Action items recap — Diego: svc acct + KMS + test endpoint by Thu; Samir: eval suite + baseline by Fri; Lena: invites + workshop deck; Priya: confirm Okta metadata and sample CSV from customer. I'll track tasks in the playbook. :white_check_mark:
Priya Nair: Sharing Okta metadata and sample CSV link: https://drive.redwood.example/catalyst/sample.csv
Diego Alvarez: Got it — will need sample payload format (CSV JSON schema). @Priya can you paste the schema here?
Priya Nair: Pasted schema in playbook doc (see link). I'll send an email to the customer's SRE with service account info.
OnboardBot: Checklist updated — 2/6 items complete. Next reminder in 24h.
